operator_notes: Solar output will drop to about 20% from 1 PM to 3 PM.

cases.description: Strict evening grid cap with battery reserve
operator_notes: Grid import must stay below 100 kWh from 6 PM to 11 PM.
Battery discharge unavailable from 7 PM to 9 PM.
Solar generation drops to 50% from 11 AM to 2 PM.
Do not discharge from 6 AM to 9 AM.
Reserve at least 80 kWh between 5 PM and 8 PM.
Grid cap of 200 kWh between 5 PM and 10 PM.
